boy.qwen_voice: A small, sweet-voiced young boy around six or seven, bright and clear, earnest and full of wonder, speaks quickly when excited and trails off when unsure.

uncle.qwen_voice: A big, warm bear of a man in his forties, deep rich baritone, jolly and generous, bursts into booming enthusiasm, then turns quiet and tender.

grandma.qwen_voice: An elderly woman, calm and precise, a warm raspy alto, teasing with a smile in her voice, unhurried.

narrator.qwen_voice: A deep, regal male voice, slow and measured, like an ancient king reading a scroll aloud, with a hint of amusement.
